title: SQL Server: DATETIMEOFFSET(7) and DATETIME2(7) keep microseconds, and the offset is dropped

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard and integrated CDC, one run

symptom: DATETIMEOFFSET(7) 2026-10-25 12:34:56.1234567 +05:30 arrives as 2026-10-25 07:04:56.123456 (the UTC instant, microseconds). DATETIME2(7) 9999-12-31 23:59:59.9999999 arrives as ...999999. No warning.
cause: The destination type is a microsecond timestamp, and a DATETIMEOFFSET value is converted to UTC.
effect: The offset and the 100 ns digit are gone, so values that differ only in those digits become equal.
fix: Not tested: keep the offset or the 100 ns digit in another column on the source.
notes: One run per mode, the same values in both.
